ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: What term best represents letter H in the diagram?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: This figure is a schematic diagram of a disease cycle around trees, with multiple stages marked by letters and connected by arrows. The letter H is located in the upper middle of the figure, next to a single detached leaf; the edge and surface of this leaf have damaged, disease-spot-like markings. It is located between the tree crown stage on the left and the branch stage on the right. Reasoning: The question asks which term the letter H can best represent. Since H directly labels a leaf affected by disease, in a disease cycle diagram this usually indicates the stage in which the leaf is infected, so H represents "Leaf infection".
